title: Household Account Credit on LandlordGuard Renewals
content:
**Terms of the credit.** The account credit on a LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy renewal rewards a household that keeps its other protection with Larkspur Mutual. A named insured with a HomeGuard Homeowners Policy in force and this LandlordGuard policy scheduled as underlying on a Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy receives 7 percent; one with exactly one of those two receives 4 percent; one with neither receives 0 percent.

The account credit is a percentage taken off the rating percentage by which the indicated renewal premium is increased after the inflation guard; that rating percentage is applied once.

## When this policy counts as scheduled on an umbrella

A LandlordGuard policy counts as scheduled on an umbrella only while the named insured holds a Larkspur umbrella in force and the umbrella's scheduling entries for this policy number outnumber its removal and lapse entries for it. The entries read are the umbrella's schedule-of-underlying entries for a landlord dwelling policy carrying this LandlordGuard policy number.

| Umbrella in force | Scheduling entries for this policy number | Removal plus lapse entries for it | Scheduled |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | 1 | 0 | yes |
| yes | 2 | 1 | yes |
| yes | 1 | 1 | no |
| no | 1 | 0 | no |

## Credit table

| HomeGuard Homeowners Policy in force | Scheduled on a Larkspur umbrella | Account credit |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 7 percent |
| yes | no | 4 percent |
| no | yes | 4 percent |
| no | no | 0 percent |

The HomeGuard condition reads whether the named insured holds a HomeGuard policy whose status is in force; a cancelled or expired HomeGuard policy does not meet it.
